Community 1st Cornwall Your Approved NHS Estates Services Partner OUR LOCAL PARTNERSHIP AREAS : CORNWALL Working together we deliver strategic estate and facilities management solutions that support the local health economy to transform health and social care delivery for the local people of Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly. Long-term partner in Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly since 2004 Over this time we have and continue to provide expert estate and facilities management, strategic planning and development support services to six state-of-the-art health and community facilities across Cornwall as well as full estate reviews and extensive capital projects and property adaptations across the local NHS estate to reflect the changing demands of our partners. Built on our long term knowledge and expertise in this area our flexible approach means that we provide solutions appropriate to meet the needs of our partner ensuring solutions are value for money and strategically driven to improve the delivery of local health and social care services. Community 1st – Your Approved Partner About Us Community 1st was formed as a partnership between the private sector and the Secretary of State for Health and Social Care in 2004 with a clear mission to provide expert estate services to develop and maintain community-based primary health, social care and other community premises. A full procurement exercise was carried out and the result was the formation of three separate companies. We were procured to provide a wide range of estate services in the Oldham, Sheffield, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly areas for an initial period of 25 years. We are approved to work in these geographic area’s without any further procurement process for every Service that we provide. Find out more Resources Community 1st have a team of over 150 professionals, providing skills and expertise across a full turnkey estate service offer. Our team includes: Health Economists Healthcare Planners Architects who specialise in Healthcare design Project Managers Property Managers Construction Managers Surveyors Facility Managers Multi-skilled Building Services Engineers UK based 24/7 Helpdesk team Smart Building Team Capital Works / Construction team From a strategic and business planning perspective we have financial modellers, an in-house legal team used to structuring NHS contract arrangements, and expertise in business case development. Services In summary we provide any service that you may require to appraise, develop or operate a building asset. Business Case Development We can provide a full business case development resource, including healthcare economic and pathway planning, financial appraisal, construction cost and time appraisal and any options appraisals that may be required. We will support you in the delivery of your vision and we pride ourselves on the successful partnerships we have developed over the years Services We provide innovative, creative and flexible options for the delivery of a wide range of estate and facilities management services that can be tailord to meet your needs. We have the experience of strategic and operational development work across our partnership areas – Sheffield, Cornwall and Oldham – understanding the challenges of these local areas, local agencies and potential impact for delivering against national policy reforms. Our team brings complementary skills to our partners teams enabling us to work together to successfully deliver your vision. Our Strategic Partnering Agreement with the local NHS means that we have Exclusivity to develop all local primary healthcare developments above a certain Capital budget. We have the resources, capacity and expertise available to provide a full range of investment, innovative funding solutions, strategic development planning, estate and facilities management services to our partners. We are more than happy to benchmark our performance against any national or local framework you care to choose. Our flexible approach to service delivery means that we can work with you to tailor a bespoke package of support, so you are not paying for services that you do not need and do not add value to your project. Just pick up the phone to discuss how we can work together. View our Partnering Services for more information about the expert estate services we offer. Partnering Services Our Partnering Services We can support our partners to understand their estate and assets, assess the options and opportunities, develop business case and funding solutions, and manage any estate transitions and plan for the future. Our long-term local partnerships mean that we understand the tight financial pressures and locally driven objectives of each of our areas of operation. Whether it is strategic planning advice, a one-off design and build, or a longer-term partnership or joint venture with investment and operational estate and FM support, we offer a range of flexible options to help deliver successful value for money projects. Feasibility and Business Case Development Our expert estate and facilities management team can work in partnership with you to support the early planning stages of your project. This will support you to identify the key information to help inform your decision making process including strategic business case development and funding applications. • Site options appraisal, feasibility and master planning • Cost analysis, market testing and value for money reviews • Strategic and operational healthcare planning • Outline and Full business case development • Design support including planning consultations and applications We understand public sector investment priorities and the principles which underpin decision-making in government. We produce compelling business applications that demonstrate evidence based strategic fit that generate economic and social returns.
